note: Journal officiel no. 34 of 2018: law 18-06 amending the criminal procedure code on the casier judiciaire, and law 18-07 on personal data. It names no system in which a police or gendarmerie station records a report or a case. The criminal records it governs are court-registry files, not said to be digital beyond bulletin no. 3 being deliverable electronically; law 18-07 excludes data processed for the prevention and prosecution of offences from its scope (Article 6).
